description: Proposes a groundwater supply well for a Texas address or coordinate and grades nearby water buy areas, from public state well records (TWDB Groundwater Database and Submitted Drillers Reports) with every well assigned to a water-bearing unit (formation). Ranks the units under and around the point by grade, then for the best unit gives a proposed total depth and screen interval, expected yield (low, design and upside, weighted by test method), water quality (TDS with sample years), depth to water and level trend, annual yield per well and under the groundwater district's per-acre cap, wells needed for a demand, the analog wells it rests on, and a leave-one-out check of how well nearby wells predict each other. Buy-area grades: A = 75th percentile yield 300+ gpm, TDS under 1,000 mg/l, median depth 1,500 ft or less, water level falling no more than 1 ft/yr, 5+ analog wells; B = the same but TDS up to 3,000 or unknown; C = 130+ gpm with 3+ analogs. Use when someone asks where to drill for water, which formation to target, how much a well will make, or how many wells and acres of rights a load needs. Screening estimates from driller and state records: confirm with a test well, a pump test and the district. Enterprise; other tiers see which units are present and the grade of the nearest buy area.

acres.description: Contiguous acres owned or leased for groundwater rights (optional; applies the district's per-acre cap).

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

demand_gpm.description: Water demand in gallons per minute (optional; demand_mgd wins if both).

demand_mgd.description: Water demand in million gallons per day (optional).

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Analog search radius in miles. Default 5, max 15.
